build_deprecate_function: build a decorator to mark a function as deprecated with a custom warning message
create_deprecate_renamed_parameter: create a decorator to deprecate a renamed function parameter and redirect it to the new name
test_deprecate_nonkeyword_arguments: test a decorator that enforces keyword-only arguments with a configurable allowed-args list
refactor_deprecate_streaming_parameter: refactor a function to deprecate the streaming parameter and map it to engine
summarize_identify_deprecations: summarize all deprecated functions across the polars package by type
